name: ANSI/IEEE Star-delta transformer form
summary: IEEE-library form of star-delta transformer: a star-delta transformer connects one winding set in star and the other in delta.
description: This reference locates star-delta transformer in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 3 phase transformers family. A star-delta transformer connects one winding set in star and the other in delta. The notation identifies winding topology; a clock-number or equivalent phase-displacement designation is still needed where system phase relationships matter. The public library uses HXF1P3SD for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace each winding, supply and accessible neutral through the complete machine or transformer connection diagram. Keep the phase arrangement, terminal labels and any clock notation attached to the device; neither the convention label nor this educational outline supplies its ratings.

Read which side is star from the declared primary and secondary labels. Y-D topology alone does not specify a complete transformer vector group. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
